title: Nutritious no-cook Korean Haricot beans Mixed-Rice-Bowl
description: Fresh, light, and show-off Korean dish featuring haricot beans, ferment-jang, and a hint of Buddhist temple tradition, served in a corn-husk wrap.
instructions: Combine 200g cooked haricot beans and 100g cooked white rice in a bowl.
Mix in 20g Korean ferment-jang, 1 tsp rice vinegar, and 1/4 tsp salt.
Add a splash of water if needed to achieve a creamy consistency.
Stir in 1 tsp toasted sesame oil and garnish with chopped green onion and 1 tsp toasted sesame seeds.
Wrap each portion in a corn husk for a unique serving vessel.
Garnish with additional green onion and sesame seeds if desired.
